entries.current_evidence: Release-gated local insert-source conflict/upsert parity, hosted mutation-source collect/stage topology retry, and typed insert-source planner fail-closed coverage for ordinary unique and temporal-overlap owner topology errors exist. Public API insert-source mutation coverage drives the current API-layer planning path through source read, unique-owner topology unavailability, deterministic 503 response, and zero commitTransaction/batch calls. It also covers successful source read, conflict-owner lookup, existing-row lookup, conflict guard evaluation, grouped transform/predicate construction, and commit-time TopologyChanged returning 503 without falling back to stale batch writes. Hosted/provisioned release evidence now runs the public insert-source upsert endpoint against a HostedProvisionedTableWriteSource: source read, conflict-owner lookup, existing-row lookup, conflict guard evaluation, routed transaction begin, and remote prepare all occur before the remote owner returns TopologyChanged, the response fails closed as 503, and no stale batch fallback route is exercised.
